تشتملي (form VIII)
# تَشْتَمِلِي (taštamilī) /taʃ.ta.mi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# تُشْتَمَلِي (tuštamalī) /tuʃ.ta.ma.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
